items.description: On the Impact Dashboard, find the Active Section with a Litter task this week.
items.expected_result: A red 'Litter' tag appears below its name.

items.description: Find the Active Section with a Weed task this week.
items.expected_result: An amber 'Weed' tag appears below its name.

items.description: Find the Active Section with a Plant task this week.
items.expected_result: A green 'Plant' tag appears below its name.

items.description: Find the Active Section with an Admin task this week.
items.expected_result: An indigo 'Admin' tag appears below its name.

items.description: Find an Active Section with no tasks scheduled this week.
items.expected_result: No tags appear below its name (layout unchanged).

items.description: Look at the Lifecycle Progress bar for the stage containing the Litter-task section.
items.expected_result: A red 'Litter' tag appears above that progress bar.
items.comment: Confirmed after seeding demo field tasks (Litter tag appears above the Clearing bar).

items.description: Look at the stage containing the Weed-task section.
items.expected_result: An amber 'Weed' tag appears above that bar.

items.description: Look at the stage containing the Plant-task section.
items.expected_result: A green 'Plant' tag appears above that bar.

items.description: Look at the stage containing the Admin-task section.
items.expected_result: No indigo 'Admin' tag above that bar (admin excluded from lifecycle).

items.description: Mark one of this week's tasks complete, then reload the dashboard.
items.expected_result: The tag still appears for that section/stage.

items.description: Ensure a task is dated next week (or last week) only.
items.expected_result: No tag appears for that section (Mon-Sun current week only).

items.description: Create a task this week with no template.
items.expected_result: No 'Custom' tag; that task contributes nothing.

items.description: Create a task this week with no section (Admin convention).
items.expected_result: Dashboard renders normally; no tag shown anywhere for that task.

items.description: With no tasks scheduled this week at all, reload the dashboard.
items.expected_result: No tags in Active Sections or Lifecycle bars; page renders normally.
